(formerly, X1 Entertainment Group.) (\"Military Metals\")."

currency.justification: The transaction involves two Canadian companies (SKRR Exploration Inc. and Military Metals Corp.) trading on Canadian exchanges (TSXV and CSE), and uses the "$" symbol, implying Canadian Dollars.
